The boxes feature a white controller with a D-pad, analog stick, and buttons, but no visible branding or model name.
A black coiled cable with a USB connector is placed in front of the boxes.
A black power cable with a UK-style 3-pin plug is visible behind the boxes.
The boxes are placed on top of a white console, which appears to be a PlayStation 4 Pro based on its shape and design.
The console has a visible 'PS4' logo on the front bezel.
The background shows a glass surface and some cluttered items, suggesting a storage or retail environment.
